title: WonderCraft Server Modpack
description:
Official NeoForge 1.21.1 modpack for the WonderCraft server.
Made for friends.
body:
**WonderCraft**

Welcome to our official server modpack! This pack is carefully put together to deliver an epic, high-adventure cooperative experience on our dedicated server. It combines technological automation, deep magical combat, and breathtaking world exploration.

🚀 Key Features & Included Mods:
World & Exploration: * Terralith: Experience a completely overhauled overworld with massive, realistic mountains, deep canyons, and stunning custom biomes.

The Aether: Step through the glowstone portal and explore the legendary dimension in the sky, filled with floating islands, unique dungeons, and powerful bosses.

Technology & Automation:

Create: Build fully functional automated factories, windmills, trains, and complex mechanical contraptions using kinetic energy. Includes extensions like Create Structures Arise, Create DragonsPlus, and Create Enchantment Industry.

Magic & Combat:

Iron's Spells 'n Books: Become a powerful wizard with a massive spell-casting system, complete with custom spellbooks, magical armor, and dangerous new structures to conquer.

Quality of Life & Performance:

Fully optimized for NeoForge with essential helper mods like JEI (Just Enough Items) for recipes, Curios for extra accessory slots, Farmers Delight for expanded cooking, and various performance/library fixes (GeckoLib, Caelus, Owo-lib) ensuring a smooth multiplayer experience.

This modpack is specially made for my friends.
